title: Product Categories with Month-over-Month Revenue Decline
description: Find all product categories that experienced a **revenue decline in at least one month** compared to the previous month. Use LAG to compare each month's revenue with the prior month's revenue within the same category.
solution_sql: WITH lagged AS (SELECT category, sale_month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sale_month) AS prev_revenue FROM monthly_sales) SELECT DISTINCT category FROM lagged WHERE prev_revenue IS NOT NULL AND revenue < prev_revenue ORDER BY category

test_cases.description: 3 categories had at least one month-over-month decline: Books (both months declined), Clothing (Mar < Feb), Electronics (both months declined). Hardware only increased.

hints: Use LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY sale_month) to retrieve the previous month's revenue within the same category.
Filter WHERE revenue < prev_revenue (and prev_revenue IS NOT NULL to exclude the first month), then SELECT DISTINCT category to list each declining category only once.
explanation: LAG partitioned by category looks back one month within each category. Electronics: Feb(9500) < Jan(10000) ✓ and Mar(9000) < Feb(9500) ✓ → declining. Clothing: Feb(5200) > Jan ✗ but Mar(4800) < Feb(5200) ✓ → declining. Hardware: always increasing ✗. Books: Feb(1800) < Jan(2000) ✓ and Mar(1600) < Feb ✓ → declining. DISTINCT removes duplicate category names since Electronics and Books each appear twice (two declining months each).
